validationNotes: Start/post-verification actual nameKey counts9345/9348. Baseline1beb09c4, clean tree/staging, previous batch/test processes all complete. Existing definitions, IDs, catalogue, image URLs, aliases, physical references and save formats preserved.

Three full official faces/basic information/mana/current restrictions and all7 exact print images reviewed: Feiwon Star2, Bolsled1, Swan4. Four exact reprints add no names. Original green Feiwon search hits are distinct. Swan later plus-marked power art still has base5000 and complete same abilities.

Feiwon Star uses native Light/Rexstar evolution, W break, Star replacement and mandatory other-own-creature entry watcher. Paid/effect entries, cost4 boundary, self/opponent/noncreature exclusion, multiple sources and actual Genmu ignore verified.

Bolsled optionally discards an actual Dragon creature using the native actual-discard continuation, then mandates destroying one targetable opponent at current power no greater than the discarded creature. Boundaries, real power modifiers, no target, wrong race, unselectable/sealed targets, creature attack cancellation, source ignore and real infinity Dragon target/JSON resume tested. Infinite discarded power imposes no upper bound, avoiding string infinity numeric comparison; finite cases stay bounded.

Swan adds each player actual top2 as separate private shields in active-player order using native ShieldTop. Its5-shield threshold counts groups and follows changing counts. Every actual own broken shield queues a mandatory tap regardless of Swan tap state; spell breaks trigger, nonbreak shield moves/destruction and enemy breaks do not. Ignored/sealed sources and opponent-turn effect entry/Waldo entry suppression verified.

Exact QA41453 tested in both seats: actual Holy Spark finishes before Swan tap; actual Aqua Surfer enters first and its entry ability and Swan may be chosen in either order through native entryOrder. No trigger timing or save-format change was needed.

48 distinct focused and194 affected regressions pass,total242. Swan choice encrypted round-trip hides other account hand and preserves legal actions/physical UIDs. Legal40-card seeded game finishes preserving80 IDs and JSON actions. Final check/audit/target9500/nameKey/baseline invariants pass.

Fixture repairs: buff is attack-only, so current enemy power uses a real powerModifier; the paid-source fixture adds its new UID to the pre-injection physical baseline; actual Aqua Surfer isdm05-024, and Shield Trigger entry ordering uses native entryOrder; sealed cards have no creature power. Infinity boundary additionally exposed and repaired the real new Bolsled filter bug.

The related standard488 Mekagenji test had an obsolete expectation that ignored printed Blocker disappears. Official QA34384 says the ability still exists. Corrected the expected selectable targets and verified actual destruction of both ignored printed and granted Blockers without restoring block permission; no old card definition changed.
